decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on to the established web-mapping offer with visible follow-up releases, it likely meets a modest aspiration level and is cheap enough to retain under the firm's innovation slack.
This plugin is close to the core offer and therefore still worth keeping, but its lower prominence and possible overlap with other search functions make it the most vulnerable if results disappoint.
The mobile layer-control component fits the firm's direction toward user-focused enterprise geospatial solutions and its homepage visibility suggests satisfactory early expectations.
As a flagship platform and product line central to the firm's stated strategic direction, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it absent clear failure.
Mobile field data capture is adjacent to the established business and relevant for both private and public customers, so in a growing industry the firm likely gives it time to prove itself.

A search extension for web map apps strongly complements the firm's installed solution base, so boundedly rational management would usually keep it while leveraging existing customer relationships and code.
